shortDescription.default: Calculate working days, discover long weekends, and compare regional holidays inside Microsoft Copilot.

longDescription.default: Holiday Planner is an SPFx Copilot Components sample for working-day calculations, long-weekend discovery, upcoming holiday exploration, holiday details, and regional comparison. It reads and writes SharePoint with the signed-in user's delegated identity and includes demo data when SharePoint is unavailable.

features.title: Holiday Planner Feature
features.description: Registers the Holiday Planner Copilot Components.
